terms.comment: Here the pole to hold on to.

phrases.latin: Cum nūlla sēdēs vacua esset, stābant, Theodōrus columnam tenēns, ut virī solent.
phrases.english: As no seat was free, they stood, Theo holding the pole, as men do.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
